## The Golden Record: Earth’s Contents and Instructions for Playback

Each Voyager spacecraft carried a gold-plated record containing selected material from Earth. Its collection included 115 analog images, natural sounds, music from different cultures and eras, and spoken greetings in 55 languages.

The record also came with a cartridge and needle, accompanied by symbolic instructions explaining the spacecraft’s origin and how to play the audio. The Golden Record thus paired a collection of material from Earth with guidance for playing it.
